medium.finding: React hook useEffect (line 38) is called after a conditional early return (line 36: if (!IS_CLOUD) return children). This violates React's Rules of Hooks — hooks must not be called conditionally. While IS_CLOUD is a module-level constant so the hook count never actually changes at runtime, this is a React anti-pattern that ESLint's exhaustive-deps rule would flag.
medium.suggested_fix: Move the early return after all hook calls: place the useEffect before the IS_CLOUD check, or restructure to use a wrapper component pattern where the outer component handles the IS_CLOUD check and the inner component always calls hooks.
